headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: RUS (12)

summary: Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix from pole position, 15.1s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium.
Lance Stroll made the biggest climb, from P20 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised SAI (5 second time penalty), BEA (5 second time penalty) and HAM (5 second time penalty).
There were 45 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 50 points over Lewis Hamilton.
